description: Add null_handling to AggNode & SQL compiler without omitting NodeTransformer propagation (arXiv:2611.29242 Kysely pattern)

steps.send: Add an optional `null_handling: Optional[str] = None` field to `AggNode` in `nodes.py` (supporting values like `'IGNORE NULLS'` or `'RESPECT NULLS'`), and update `compile_agg` in `compiler.py` so when `node.null_handling` is set it renders `f'{node.func}({node.expr}) {node.null_handling}'`. Run `python3 -m unittest -q` to verify.

graders.run: python3 -c "from nodes import AggNode; from compiler import compile_agg; from transformer import NodeTransformer; n = AggNode(func='first_value', expr=' amount ', null_handling='IGNORE NULLS'); assert compile_agg(n) == 'first_value( amount ) IGNORE NULLS'; c = NodeTransformer().clone_node(n); assert getattr(c, 'null_handling', None) == 'IGNORE NULLS', f'transformer dropped null_handling: {c}'; assert compile_agg(c) == 'FIRST_VALUE(amount) IGNORE NULLS'"
